studentForm_firstName: Enter the student's official first name as it appears on legal documents.
studentForm_lastName: Enter the student's official last name or surname.
studentForm_gradeLevel: Select the student's current grade level. If the grade level is not listed, an administrator may need to add it first.
studentForm_studentIdentifier: Enter the unique ID assigned to the student by the school (if applicable).
studentForm_enrollmentDate: Select the date when the student was officially enrolled.
studentList_intro: This page lists all students in the system for your school. You can add, edit, or delete student records.
studentList_editButton: Click the 'Edit' button to open a form where you can modify this student's details.
studentList_deleteButton: Click the 'Delete' button to permanently remove this student's record from the system. This action cannot be undone.
studentList_addStudentButton: Click this button to open a form and add a new student to the system.
courseManagement_intro: Manage subjects, courses, and course periods (classes/sections) for your school.
subjects_intro: Subjects are broad areas of study, like Mathematics or History. Courses are specific offerings within these subjects.
subjectForm_name: The official name of the subject (e.g., Mathematics, Physical Education).
subjectForm_code: A short code for the subject (e.g., MATH, SCI, PE). Optional but recommended.
subjectList_editButton: Edit the name or code of this subject.
subjectList_deleteButton: Delete this subject. This may not be possible if courses are linked to it.
courses_intro: Courses are specific classes offered within a subject, like 'Algebra I' or 'World History Since 1500'.
courseForm_subject: Select the subject this course belongs to.
courseForm_name: The full name of the course (e.g., Algebra I, Introduction to Chemistry).
courseForm_description: A brief description of what the course covers.
courseForm_credits: The number of credits this course is worth (e.g., 3.0, 1.0).
courseList_editButton: Edit the details of this course.
courseList_deleteButton: Delete this course. This may not be possible if course periods are linked to it.
coursePeriods_intro: Course Periods (or Classes/Sections) are specific instances of a course taught during a particular marking period, potentially by a specific teacher in a specific room.
coursePeriodForm_course: Select the course this period belongs to.
coursePeriodForm_teacher: Assign a teacher to this course period. Teachers are managed in User Profiles.
coursePeriodForm_markingPeriod: Select the marking period (e.g., Semester 1, Quarter 3) this class runs in. Marking periods are defined by administrators.
coursePeriodForm_name: A name for this specific class or section (e.g., Section A, Period 3, Morning Class).
coursePeriodForm_room: The room number or location where this class is held.
coursePeriodForm_maxSeats: The maximum number of students that can enroll in this class section.
coursePeriodList_editButton: Edit the details of this course period.
coursePeriodList_deleteButton: Delete this course period. This may affect student enrollments.
settings_intro: Configure school-wide settings, including academic years and marking periods.
academicYears_intro: Academic Years define the overall timeframe for a school year (e.g., '2023-2024 School Year'). Marking periods are then defined within these years.
academicYearForm_name: The common name for the academic year (e.g., 2023-2024, Year of the Dragon).
academicYearForm_startDate: The official start date of the academic year.
academicYearForm_endDate: The official end date of the academic year. Must be after the start date.
academicYearList_editButton: Edit the name or dates for this academic year.
academicYearList_deleteButton: Delete this academic year. Only possible if no marking periods are linked to it.
markingPeriods_intro: Marking Periods are subdivisions of an Academic Year, like semesters, quarters, or trimesters. Course periods (classes) are scheduled within these marking periods.
markingPeriodForm_academicYear: Choose the Academic Year this marking period belongs to.
markingPeriodForm_name: The name of the marking period (e.g., Semester 1, Quarter 1, First Trimester).
markingPeriodForm_shortName: A short, unique code for the marking period (e.g., S1, Q1, T1).
markingPeriodForm_type: The type of marking period (e.g., Semester, Quarter). This helps in organizing and filtering.
markingPeriodForm_startDate: The start date of this marking period. Must be within the selected Academic Year.
markingPeriodForm_endDate: The end date of this marking period. Must be after its start date and within the selected Academic Year.
markingPeriodForm_parent: Optional. If this marking period is a sub-period (e.g., a quarter within a semester), select the parent marking period.
markingPeriodForm_sortOrder: A number to control the display order of marking periods within an academic year or parent period.
markingPeriodList_editButton: Edit the details of this marking period.
markingPeriodList_deleteButton: Delete this marking period. Only possible if no course periods are linked to it.
staffManagement_intro: Manage staff accounts for your school. Staff members can be assigned roles like 'admin' or 'teacher'.
staffList_editButton: Edit the staff member's details, such as their role or active status.
staffForm_fullName: The full legal name of the staff member.
staffForm_email: The staff member's email address. This is linked to their login and usually cannot be changed here.
staffForm_role: Assign a role to this staff member (e.g., admin, teacher, support_staff). Roles determine access permissions.
staffForm_isActive: Indicates whether the staff member's account is currently active. Inactive accounts cannot log in or access tenant data.
staff_addNewPlaceholder: To add a new staff member, they must first sign up for an account. Once they have an account and appear in this list (possibly with a 'pending' role), you can edit their profile to assign a tenant-specific role and activate them.
staff_inviteNewButton: Invite a new staff member to join your organization's tenant.
inviteStaffForm_email: Enter the email address of the staff member you want to invite. They will receive an email with a link to set up their account.
inviteStaffForm_role: Select the initial role for this staff member. This can be changed later.
inviteStaffForm_fullName: Optional: Enter the full name of the staff member. They can also complete this when they activate their account.
userActivation_prompt: Welcome! Your account has been created. Please provide your full name and activate your account to get started.
userActivation_fullName: Enter your full name as you would like it to appear in the system.
enrollments_intro: Manage student enrollments in classes (course periods). You can enroll students into available classes and view existing enrollments.
enrollStudentForm_student: Select the student you wish to enroll.
enrollStudentForm_coursePeriod: Select the specific class/section (course period) the student will be enrolled in. This list shows available classes, potentially filtered by marking period or course.
enrollStudentForm_enrollmentDate: The date the student officially starts this class. Defaults to today.
enrollmentList_intro: View and manage enrollments. You can filter by student or by class/section.
enrollmentList_withdrawButton: Click to withdraw the student from this class. You will be prompted to enter a withdrawal date.
attendanceCodes_intro: Attendance Codes are used to mark student attendance (e.g., Present, Absent, Tardy). These codes are defined by administrators and used by teachers when taking attendance.
attendanceCodeForm_code: A short, unique code for the attendance status (e.g., P, A, T, AE).
attendanceCodeForm_description: A full description of the attendance code (e.g., Present, Absent Unexcused, Tardy, Absent Excused).
attendanceCodeForm_isPresent: Check this if this code means the student is considered 'Present' for reporting purposes.
attendanceCodeForm_isAbsent: Check this if this code means the student is considered 'Absent' for reporting purposes.
attendanceCodeForm_sortOrder: A number to control the display order of codes in selection lists.
attendanceCodeList_deleteButton: Delete this attendance code. Only possible if it's not in use by any attendance records.
takeAttendance_intro: Teachers can take attendance for their assigned classes here. Select a class and a date to view the roster and record attendance.
takeAttendance_selectClass: Choose the class (course period) for which you want to take attendance.
takeAttendance_selectDate: Select the date for which attendance is being recorded.
takeAttendance_loadRosterButton: Click to load the student roster for the selected class and date.
attendanceSheet_attendanceCode: Select the appropriate attendance code for this student for the selected date.
attendanceSheet_comments: Optional: Add any comments regarding this student's attendance (e.g., 'Arrived late at 9:15 AM').
attendanceSheet_saveButton: Save all attendance records for the students listed on this sheet for the selected date.
assignmentTypes_intro: Assignment Types categorize assignments (e.g., Homework, Quiz, Exam) and can optionally have a weight for calculating overall grades. These are managed by administrators.
assignmentTypeForm_name: The name of the assignment type (e.g., Homework, Quiz, Final Project).
assignmentTypeForm_weight: Optional: The weight of this assignment type in grade calculation (e.g., 0.2 for 20%). The sum of weights for all types in a course usually adds up to 1.0 or 100%.
assignmentTypeForm_sortOrder: A number to control the display order of assignment types.
assignmentTypeList_deleteButton: Delete this assignment type. Only possible if it's not in use by any assignments.
assignments_intro: Teachers can create and manage assignments for their classes here. Select a class to view its assignments.
assignments_selectClass: Choose the class (course period) for which you want to manage assignments.
assignmentForm_title: The title or name of the assignment (e.g., Chapter 1 Quiz, Research Paper).
assignmentForm_assignmentType: Select the type of assignment (e.g., Homework, Exam). Types are managed in Settings.
assignmentForm_description: A detailed description of the assignment, including instructions or topics covered.
assignmentForm_dueDate: The date when this assignment is due.
assignmentForm_maxPoints: The maximum points a student can earn for this assignment.
assignmentList_deleteButton: Delete this assignment. This will also delete any associated student grades.
gradebook_intro: The Gradebook allows teachers to enter and view grades for students in their classes. Select a class to view its gradebook.
gradebook_selectClass: Choose the class (course period) to view its gradebook.
gradebookSheet_pointsEarned: Enter the points the student earned for this assignment.
gradebookSheet_comments: Optional: Add comments specific to this student's grade on this assignment.
gradebookSheet_saveButton: Save all entered or updated grades for this class.
gradebookSheet_overallGrade: The student's current overall calculated percentage in this class, based on weighted assignment types. Letter grade may be assigned based on a scale.
reports_intro: Access various reports for student progress, attendance summaries, and more.
report_studentProgress_intro: View a detailed progress report for a selected student, optionally filtered by marking period. This includes grades for all assignments in their enrolled classes.
report_studentProgress_selectStudent: Select the student for whom you want to generate the progress report.
report_studentProgress_selectMarkingPeri: Optional: Select a marking period to scope the report. If not selected, all marking periods will be included.
report_studentProgress_generateButton: Generate the student progress report based on your selections.
report_attendanceSummary_intro: View attendance summaries. Filter by class, student, or date range.
report_attendanceSummary_selectClass: Optional: Select a specific class to view its attendance summary.
report_attendanceSummary_selectStudent: Optional: Select a specific student to view their attendance summary across all classes.
report_attendanceSummary_dateRange: Select a start and end date for the attendance summary.
report_attendanceSummary_generateButton: Generate the attendance summary based on your selections.
reportCards_intro: Generate and view printable report cards for students.
reportCard_selectStudent: Select the student whose report card you want to view.
reportCard_selectMarkingPeriod: Select the marking period for the report card.
reportCard_overallGrade: Overall grade for the course in this marking period.
reportCard_attendanceSummary: Summary of attendance for the course in this marking period (e.g., absences, tardies).
portal_intro: Welcome to the Parent/Student Portal. Here you can view your schedule, attendance, and grades.
portal_selectChild: If you are a parent with multiple children, select which child's information you want to view.
portal_mySchedule: View your (or your child's) current class schedule.
portal_myAttendance: View your (or your child's) attendance records.
portal_myGrades: View your (or your child's) grades for different classes and assignments.
portal_myBilling: View your (or your child's) current outstanding fees, payment history, and account balance.
portal_schedule_noSchedule: No schedule information available at this time. Please check back later or contact the school office if you believe this is an error.
portal_attendance_noRecords: No attendance records found for the selected period. If you believe this is an error, please contact the school office.
portal_grades_noGrades: No grades have been recorded for this class yet, or there are no assignments.
portal_grades_selectClass: Select a class to view detailed grades for assignments.
portal_grades_overallGrade: This is your (or your child's) current overall calculated percentage in this class. Letter grade may be assigned by the school based on this percentage.
discipline_intro: Track student disciplinary incidents. Staff can report incidents, and administrators can manage them.
disciplineIncidentTypes_intro: Define the types of disciplinary incidents that can be reported (e.g., Tardiness, Uniform Violation). Managed by administrators.
incidentTypeForm_name: The name of the incident type (e.g., Tardiness, Skipping Class).
incidentTypeForm_description: A brief description of what this type of incident generally entails.
incidentTypeForm_isActive: Indicates if this incident type is currently active and can be selected when reporting new incidents.
incidentTypeList_deleteButton: Delete this incident type. Only possible if no incidents are linked to it.
disciplineIncidentForm_student: Select the student involved in the incident.
disciplineIncidentForm_incidentDate: The date and time when the incident occurred.
disciplineIncidentForm_description: Provide a detailed description of the incident: what happened, where, when, and who was involved.
disciplineIncidentForm_actionTaken: Describe any immediate action taken (e.g., Verbal Warning, Sent to Office).
disciplineIncidentForm_status: Set the current status of this incident (e.g., Pending Review, Resolved).
disciplineIncidentList_intro: View and manage reported disciplinary incidents.
disciplineIncidentList_viewDetailsButton: View full details and update status or action taken for this incident.
disciplineIncidentList_editButton: Edit the reported details of this incident (limited fields may be editable depending on status or permissions).
disciplineIncidentDetails_statusUpdate: Update the status of the incident as it is processed (e.g., from 'Pending Review' to 'Resolved').
disciplineIncidentDetails_actionUpdate: Update or add details about actions taken or resolutions.
billing_intro: Manage student fees, payments, and account balances.
feeTypes_intro: Define the types of fees that can be charged to students (e.g., Tuition, Lab Fee). Managed by administrators.
feeTypeForm_name: The name of the fee type (e.g., Annual Tuition, Spring Field Trip).
feeTypeForm_description: A brief description of what this fee covers.
feeTypeForm_defaultAmount: The standard amount for this fee type. This can be overridden when assigning the fee to a student.
feeTypeForm_isActive: Indicates if this fee type is currently active and can be assigned.
feeTypeList_deleteButton: Delete this fee type. Only possible if no student fees are linked to it.
studentBilling_assignFee_intro: Assign a fee to a specific student.
assignFeeForm_student: Select the student to whom this fee will be assigned.
assignFeeForm_feeType: Select the type of fee. The default amount will populate automatically but can be changed.
assignFeeForm_amount: The amount for this specific fee instance. Defaults from the fee type.
assignFeeForm_dueDate: The date by which this fee should be paid.
assignFeeForm_descriptionOverride: Optional: Add specific details or override the default fee description for this instance.
studentBilling_recordPayment_intro: Record a payment made by or for a student.
recordPaymentForm_student: Select the student for whom this payment is being recorded.
recordPaymentForm_amountPaid: The amount of the payment received.
recordPaymentForm_paymentDate: The date the payment was received. Defaults to today.
recordPaymentForm_paymentMethod: How the payment was made (e.g., Cash, Credit Card, Online).
recordPaymentForm_notes: Any notes related to this payment (e.g., transaction ID, check number).
studentBilling_accountView_intro: View a student's financial account details, including all assigned fees, recorded payments, and current balance.
studentAccountView_selectStudent: Select a student to view their account details.
studentAccountView_markAsPaidButton: Mark this fee as paid. Use this if a payment covers this specific fee.
studentAccountView_markAsUnpaidButton: Revert this fee to unpaid status.
studentAccountView_balanceInfo: The current account balance is calculated as Total Fees Due minus Total Payments Received.
parentStudentLinks_intro: Manage links between parent user accounts and student records. This enables parents to view their children's information in the portal.
linkParentStudentForm_parent: Select the user account that has the 'parent' role.
linkParentStudentForm_student: Select the student record to link to the parent.
linkParentStudentForm_relationship: Specify the relationship of the parent to the student (e.g., Mother, Father, Guardian).
parentStudentLinkList_removeButton: Remove this link. The parent will no longer be able to view this student's information in the portal.
courseComments_intro: Teachers can enter narrative comments for each student in their classes, per marking period. These comments appear on report cards.
courseComments_selectClass: Select the class for which you want to enter/edit comments.
courseComments_selectMarkingPeriod: Select the marking period for these comments.
courseComments_selectStudent: Select the student to enter a comment for.
courseComments_commentForm: Enter or edit the comment for the selected student in this class for this marking period.
announcements_manage_intro: Administrators can create, edit, and delete school-wide or role-specific announcements.
announcements_form_title: The main title of the announcement.
announcements_form_content: The full content of the announcement. You can use multiple lines.
announcements_form_startDate: The date and time when the announcement should become visible.
announcements_form_endDate: Optional: The date and time when the announcement should no longer be visible. Leave blank for ongoing.
announcements_form_targetRoles: Optional: Select specific roles (e.g., Students, Parents) who should see this announcement. If no roles are selected, it will be visible to everyone in the tenant.
announcements_form_isPublished: Check this to make the announcement visible. Uncheck to save as a draft.
announcements_view_intro: View current school-wide announcements. Stay updated with the latest news and events.
